question: A shopkeeper raises the price of an article (Rs. 1000) by 20%, then offers a 10% discount on the raised price. What is the net change?
explanation: Method 1 (sequential): 1000 x 120/100 = Rs. 1200; x 90/100 = Rs. 1080. Method 2 (fractions): 1000 x 120/100 x 90/100 = Rs. 1080. Both agree: 8% increase.
worked_solution: Method 1 (sequential): 1000 x 120/100 = Rs. 1200; x 90/100 = Rs. 1080. Method 2 (fractions): 1000 x 120/100 x 90/100 = Rs. 1080. Both agree: 8% increase.
